title: seqFISH Tissue Preservation
author: Long Cai
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7e7hjhn
materials: Clean surface with RNAzap. Make the following solutions. 1L PBS 1x, RNAse-free 1.take 1 L RNAse-free water bottle 2.use serologic pipet and draw up 100 mL water into another container 3.add 100 mL of 10x RNase-free PBS 4.mix thoroughly 50% sucrose 1.tare 1 L RNase-free disposable container 2.take 500 g RNAse-free sucrose container 3.add RNAse-free water to sucrose and transfer to 1 L container 4.continue to add RNAse-free water until mass to 1 kg 5.mix thoroughly, may need agitation on platform at RT for some time 6.store at 4⁰C NOTE: for fixation, minimum PFA to tissue volume is 20:1, ideal closer to 50:1

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Pieces
steps.instruction: Cut freshly dissected tissue into small pieces. For heart tissue, cut slabs to dimensions of 2 cm x 1 cm x 0.4 cm (with the 2 cm dimension extending from epicardium to endocardium).

steps.title: Prepare PFA Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 4% PFA in 1x PBS. For 4 tissues, prepare 120 mL total (30 mL per tissue) in 50 mL conical tubes.

steps.title: Fix Tissue in PFA
steps.instruction: Place each tissue piece in a 50 mL tube (or smaller if pieces were cut smaller) containing 4% PFA, ensuring the sample is completely covered. Incubate at RT for 3 hours.

steps.title: Wash Tissue
steps.instruction: Wash the tissue three times with an equal volume (30 mL) of 1x PBS to remove PFA.

substeps.instruction: Leave a small amount of extra liquid in the bottom between each wash.

steps.title: Incubate in 10% Sucrose
steps.instruction: Place the tissue in a 50 mL conical tube with 10 mL of 10% Sucrose at RT.

substeps.instruction: Wait for the sample to sink to the bottom (minimum incubation time of 30 min).
Remove supernatant before the next bath.

steps.title: Incubate in 20% Sucrose
steps.instruction: Place the tissue in 20% Sucrose at RT and wait for it to sink.

steps.title: Preserve in 30% Sucrose
steps.instruction: Place the tissue in 30% sucrose at 4°C for shipping. Ensure there is sufficient solution in the container (e.g., 50 mL of 30% sucrose for a 50 mL conical tube).
